instruction: Our starting point is in front of a pathway, turn around and enter the house that's in front of you... On your right there's a round table with a vase on top, on your left there's a dining table with some beige chairs, walk past the round table towards the patio, we're now facing towards the patio, step into it, turn around, enter the house and then turn towards the right... On your left there's a living room, within the living room there are couches, two chairs, a coffee table and a TV, walk towards the back of the couch that's on the right... You'll come across a shelf with what appears to be a picture with some decorations... On the right there's a plant... walk towards that plant... Turn slightly to the right... In front of you there's a room, and we're facing towards a wall with a window, walk towards the wall... You'll be facing the window, and that's your destination.
